items.title: Bomb threats on flights in Europe cause disruption, no devices found
items.brief: At least seven flights and a cruise ship in Europe received bomb threats on Tuesday, causing disruption at airports although no devices were discovered.

items.title: Convicted murderer who escaped through Tennessee prison fence is captured, officials say
items.brief: A convicted murderer who escaped a Tennessee jail was apprehended and brought back into custody, officials said –– nine days after he breached the prison fence and drove off in a stolen truck.

items.title: Spanish soccer player Jesús de Miguel dies after on-pitch collision
items.brief: Soccer player Jesús de Miguel has died after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match on Monday, his club CD Tenerife has said.

items.title: Child in New York dies after contracting measles, the state’s first such death in 30 years
items.brief: A child in Lewis County, New York, has died after contracting measles, officials announced Monday.

items.title: An hour-by-hour guide to election night poll closings
items.brief: It’s Election Day, and the balance of power in Washington is at stake as Americans vote to determine control of the Senate and House of Representatives — plus, settle races for governor and decide many other key issues.

items.title: Storm soaks central US on Election Day after causing deadly flooding, voting disruptions in Southwest
items.brief: Widespread rain is draped across the central United States on Election Day from the same storm that caused deadly and historic flooding in the Southwest over the past few days.
